svg.text: 6 cams x 225 positions x 4 patches = 5400 tokens
Temporal Cross-Attention (only 3 current cameras, 6 layers total)
Reshape x: (B*6, 900, C) --> (B, 6, 225, 4, C) then select cam 3-5
q_in = reshape to (B*2700, 1, 1024) -- each patch is a query
cat[history, current] --> kv_in (B*2700, 18, C) -- 17 hist + 1 curr
Q(2700,1) x KV(2700,18) -- each patch attends to 18 timesteps
Reshape back: (B, 6, 225, 4, C) --> (B*6, 900, C) continue to next layer
Merge 4 patches per position into 1 token
6 cams x 225pos x 4pat per-cam spatial attn + 6x temporal attn aggregate 4 patches/pos project to LLM hidden dim
